text_block_list.text:
I join Голд Шипп on our first shrine visit of
the new
year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Dang it! Why?! Say it ain't sooo!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Голд Шипп gets upset
about
something the second we step
onto the grounds.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
How can this be? It's only been a year,
and yet!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Yakisoba, of course! What else would I
be talking
about?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Every year at this time, a bunch of food
stands
pop up at shrines and stuff, and
there's always
been a yakisoba stall!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But look! I don't see a single yakisoba
stand
around this year!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Why?! Did yakisoba do something
wrong?! Did
it?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I don't know what goes into setting up
the food
stands, but it's probably just a
coincidence that
no yakisoba stalls are
set up this year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Curses upon curses! How dare they treat
yakisoba
with such disrespect!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Looks like I have to take things into my
own
hands!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind! This year, I'm
appointing
myself as the Umamusume
ambassador of
yakisoba!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I'll spread the word and educate the
whole world
about what makes yakisoba
so great...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
And I won't stop until yakisoba retakes
its rightful
place as the world's best junk
food!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
And you'll be right behind me, of course!
So,
what's our first strategy?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I doubt there's really a right answer in
this
situation, but I try to answer
genuinely.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
We must deepen our understanding of its
deliciousness.
We have to learn the art of making yakisoba.
We have to brainstorm new recipes.

text_block_list.text: Deepen our understanding, you say?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is imperative that I am the world's
number
one connoisseur of yakisoba...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, how else can I get others to

understand its rich appeal?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Yakisoba... art?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Now I see! The problem with the world
of
yakisoba is its lack of flash and
artistry!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Just think of the headlines if I
miraculously
whipped out a plate of
yakisoba from thin air!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: New recipes?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
You're absolutely right... Regular ol'
yakisoba
can't take the world by storm!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Luckily, we live in a era of unrestricted

self-expression. I'm free to make
yakisoba into a
dessert or even get rid of
the noodles altogether!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Listen up, yakisoba! I'm going to do
everything I
can to understand you! I'll
love you more deeply
and passionately
than anyone!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
It's time to dive into the ocean of
limitless
possibilities! Let's paint the
horizon with a
yakisoba rainbow!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I know my true path now! I'll revitalize
the
yakisoba industry with epic-level
magic tricks!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
